rule: the project cards are the navigation
title: Deal
description: A hand of five real projects on red felt. Move the cards, flip their facts and spread all 28 into a labelled arc.
signature: A hand-rolled Verlet table deals at 60ms intervals. Throws preserve release velocity, predict their landing and return off-table cards to the deck; real CSS card backs hold the facts.
holdback: The phone fan hides most other names behind the selected card, and the full deck then exposes only one or two projects at a time. Its selected-project actions may refer to a card outside the current horizontal view, so the In your hand label matters. The care card's bare 31 lacks a unit until flipped. Playing-card grammar is familiar and the opened cases are conventional; exceptional physics or interruption craft has not been observed. These limit the score without requiring another repair round.
